title: 第5章 草丛中的黑影第6章 往前走莫回头
slug: 无敌镖人开局护送灭世帝女
lines: 陈观提着蹬腿的兔子来到不远处的小河边，从靴子里抽出一柄短刀。
剥皮、去内脏、清洗，没有半分拖泥带水，一气呵成。
三两下洗涮干净后，他随手折了根结实的树枝，将处理好的兔子整个串起，随后上方架起火堆。
一只原本活蹦乱跳的兔子，就这样在烈火的炙烤下，展现了它应该有的命运。
洛璃远远地坐在石头上，拧开随身携带的水袋，小口的灌了一口，随后擦了擦嘴。
忽然，她小巧的鼻子微微一皱，一股从未闻过的辛辣香味，裹挟着肉香，悄无声息的钻进了她的鼻腔。
侧头看去。
陈观拿出一个竹筒，在那焦黄的烤兔上，挥洒着五颜六色的粉末。
滋啦——！
油脂滴落火中，爆起一串火星，浓郁的香味也随之变得更加勾人。
这股味道……
她从未闻过，辛辣中带着一种奇特的芳香，跟她以往在乡镇酒家吃过的野味截然不同。
洛璃竟不自觉地咽了咽口水。
这个家伙……
定是将所有的心思都钻研到了吃喝上，不然一个从小在山村里长大的野小子，不饿死就不错了。
怎么可能有钱习武，还成为十里八乡最有名的镖人？
啪啪啪！
火堆中枯枝炸响，辛辣的肉香肆无忌惮地飘散开来。
洛璃的肚子，竟然不争气的发出了“咕咕”
的轻响。
很快，陈观便将那只烤得外焦里嫩、油光锃亮的烤兔从火堆上拿了下来。
他凑到鼻尖使劲闻了闻，脸上露出一丝满意的神情。
“嗯，不错，这个烤兔比昨晚红烧的要香多了。”
说着，他侧头，朝洛璃的方向瞥了一眼。
洛璃赶紧扭过头去，装作在看远处的风景。
她等啊等，等啊……
预想中，那个家伙推向自己接触过的男人一样，会屁颠颠的将烤好的兔子双手奉上。
可等了半天，除了那越来越浓郁的肉香味，再无其他动静。
她耐不住好奇，悄悄侧过头，用余光偷瞄。
这一看，差点没把她气得当场晕过去。
只见那个家伙正一个人蹲在块大石头上，抱着一整只肥硕的烤兔，旁若无人的大快朵颐。
吃的满嘴流油。
她的呢？！
洛璃当即气血上涌，猛地从石头上站起，几步冲到陈观面前，指着他手里的兔子，怒道。
“我的呢？”
陈观停下撕咬的动作，挂着满嘴的油渍，一脸疑惑看着她。

;;
Chen Guan carried the kicking rabbit to a small river not far away and pulled out a short knife from his boots.
Peeling, gutting, and cleaning were done in one go without any fuss.
After washing it clean in twos and twos, he casually folded a strong branch, strung the whole rabbit together, and then set up a fire above.
A rabbit that was originally lively and hopping, just like this, under the scorching fire, showed the fate it should have.
Luo Li sat far away on a stone, unscrewed the water bag she carried with her, took a small sip, and then wiped her mouth.
Suddenly, her small nose wrinkled slightly, and a spicy fragrance that she had never smelled before, wrapped in the aroma of meat, quietly entered her nostrils.
Look sideways.
Chen Guan took out a bamboo tube and sprinkled colorful powder on the brown roast rabbit.
Zila——!
The grease dripped into the fire, bursting into a string of sparks, and the rich fragrance became more alluring.
This smell...
She had never smelled it before, and it had a strange aroma in the spicy food, which was completely different from the game she had eaten at the township restaurant in the past.
Luo Li swallowed unconsciously.
This guy...
He must have put all his thoughts into eating and drinking, otherwise a wild boy who grew up in a mountain village would be great if he didn't starve to death.
How could he have enough money to practice martial arts and become the most famous bodyguard in every country in the world?
Bang bang bang!
The dead branches exploded in the fire, and the spicy aroma of meat wafted unbridled.
Luo Li's stomach unexpectedly let out a "gurgling" sound.
The soft sound.
Soon, Chen Guan took the roasted rabbit, which was charred on the outside and tender on the inside, and shiny on the inside, from the fire.
He brought it to the tip of his nose and smelled it vigorously, with a look of satisfaction on his face.
"Well, yes, this roasted rabbit is much more fragrant than the braised rabbit last night."
As he spoke, he turned his head and glanced in Luo Li's direction.
Luo Li quickly turned her head and pretended to be looking at the scenery in the distance.
She waited and waited and waited...
As expected, the guy would push the roasted rabbit with his hands like he pushed towards the men he had come into contact with.
But after waiting for a long time, there was no other sound except the increasingly rich smell of meat.
Unable to bear her curiosity, she quietly turned her head and peeked out of the corner of her eye.
The sight almost made her faint from anger.
I saw that guy squatting on a big rock alone, holding a whole fat roast rabbit, and feasting on it as if no one else was around.
My mouth is full of oil after eating.
What about hers? !
"You!"
Luo Li's blood immediately surged, she stood up from the stone suddenly, rushed to Chen Guan in a few steps, pointed at the rabbit in his hand, and said angrily.
"Where's mine?"
Chen Guan stopped biting, his mouth full of oil stains, and looked at her with confusion.
